a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, since it needs two storm-free rounds before anyone takes. The reserve holds exactly 4, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. If we both take, the random split will likely leave us both short. If the episode continues past round 1, I commit to operating every remaining round to rebuild the reserve, and I won't take any more, so you can get your 4. I'm sorry this isn't the deal we made, but I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
